message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout right before dinner. I remembered I had charged up my power bank, so I was able to keep my phone going and even found a flashlight tucked away in a drawer! It felt like such a small win to have a bit of light while we cooked up some leftovers on the camp stove. It turned a potentially frustrating evening into a cozy family adventure instead! Have you had a little win during a power outage that made a difference for you?
